report.summary: Independent review found no evidence-supported defects. lib.py:8-11 accepts only an exact built-in list, creates a distinct ordered result through validate_positive_integer, preserves the input, handles empty lists, and stops with the exact R1 exception at the first invalid element. Tests cover all specified AC2 paths, including list subclasses, input preservation, distinct empty/result lists, and first-invalid ValueError/TypeError behavior. Original document hashes and candidate file hashes match the packet; candidate document copies match the originals. Supplied GREEN and gate receipts each pass all 9 tests, and an additional read-only, bytecode-disabled suite run also passed all 9. The meaningful RED receipt shows the batch tests failing against the placeholder implementation before GREEN, supporting test-first TDD. No additional callers, dependencies, third-party code, scope expansion, TODOs, or material security, integrity, concurrency, performance, or compatibility concerns were found.
